items.title: Introduce transition-orchestrator.ts coordinating one transition
items.context: Create packages/main/src/handlers/transition-orchestrator.ts, not core/, because it coordinates handler-layer gate/effect modules (phase-gates.ts / transition-effects.ts / done-effects.ts) and a core/ file importing handlers/ would invert Core/Shell layering. It owns one transition's actor lifecycle, DONE merge lock scope, state mutation/writeStory ordering, pre/post gate ordering, and effect invocation. External CLI behavior and lifecycle semantics must remain unchanged (behavior-preserving explicit orchestrator). Note runDonePreMergeGate is gate-shaped (before actor.send) while applyDoneMergeEffects is effect-shaped (after writeStory phase=DONE) — the orchestrator must respect this straddling of the actor.send boundary.
items.userSees: DEV 后全仓 `rg "actor\.stop"` 只在 transition-orchestrator.ts 命中；phase-gates.ts / done-effects.ts 不再调 actor.stop()。orchestrator 是 actor 生命周期与 DONE merge lock 的唯一 owner。

happy.desc: transition-orchestrator.ts 存在于 packages/main/src/handlers/ 且 export runStoryTransition 函数 -> tsc --noEmit 编译通过，模块可被 story-advance.ts import; WHY: 证明 orchestrator 文件落地且编译正确
全仓 rg "actor\.stop" 只在 transition-orchestrator.ts 命中 -> phase-gates.ts / done-effects.ts / story-advance.ts 零命中; WHY: 证明 actor 生命周期唯一 owner 收拢完成（硬验收 #1）

全仓 rg "createStoryActor|actor\.start\(|actor\.send\(" 除 machine.ts 定义外只在 transition-orchestrator.ts 命中 -> story-advance.ts / phase-gates.ts / done-effects.ts 不再直接创建或操作 actor; WHY: 完整的 actor 生命周期 create/start/send/stop 四操作均由 orchestrator 独占

acquireDoneMainMergeLock + release 调用点全仓 grep 只在 transition-orchestrator.ts 的一个 try/finally 块内 -> lock scope 覆盖 runDonePreMergeGate + actor.send + writeStory + applyDoneMergeEffects 全程; WHY: 证明 DONE merge lock scope 结构化（硬验收 #2）

orchestrator 内 DONE 路径按 runDonePreMergeGate -> actor.send -> writeStory(phase=DONE) -> applyDoneMergeEffects 顺序调用 -> 代码逐行检查确认该顺序; WHY: 证明 pre/post gate 顺序显式化，runDonePreMergeGate 在 actor.send 前（gate 形），applyDoneMergeEffects 在 writeStory 后（effect 形）

edge.desc: phase-gates.ts resolveGuardFailure 不再调 actor.stop() -> 函数签名移除 actor 参数或移除 stop 调用; WHY: 确认 guard 失败路径的 actor 生命周期也由 orchestrator 统一管理
done-effects.ts runDonePreMergeGate 的 stray-file 分支不再调 actor.stop() -> 该代码路径改为 throw 后由 orchestrator finally 清理; WHY: 确认异常路径的 actor 也被 orchestrator 兜底
transition-orchestrator.ts 的 finally 块在所有退出路径（正常返回 / guard 失败 throw / gate 失败 throw / effect 失败 throw）都执行 actor.stop() -> 代码分析确认无遗漏路径; WHY: 防止 actor 泄漏

adversarial.desc: 在 phase-gates.ts / done-effects.ts 中搜索 actor.stop / actor.send / createStoryActor 等 actor 操作符号 -> 确认零命中，排除纯搬迁假接管（Option B）; WHY: 对抗「把 inline 协调原样搬进 orchestrator 但被调模块仍保留 actor 操作」的假接管
检查 transition-orchestrator.ts 的 import 图：它 import phase-gates / transition-effects / done-effects -> 反向检查这三个文件不 import transition-orchestrator.ts -> 无循环 import; WHY: 对抗搬迁引入循环依赖

orchestrator DONE lock 的 try/finally scope 从 acquireDoneMainMergeLock 开始到 finally release 结束 -> 中间不存在任何 return / break / 跳出 try 的控制流 -> lock scope 无空洞; WHY: 对抗 lock scope 结构化表面通过但实际有提前 return 绕过 finally 的漏洞

items.title: Reduce story_advance.ts to a thin handler delegating to the orchestrator
items.context: story_advance.ts becomes a thin handler: parse CLI args, call transition-orchestrator, shape the response. It must no longer contain inline transition coordination, gate-runner bodies, or merge implementation. A thin handler means real delegation, not just moved comments. story-advance.ts line count drops substantially again.
items.userSees: 开发者 grep story-advance.ts 找不到 inline git merge / git worktree remove / actor 生命周期编排 / gate 串接；story-advance.ts 只剩参数入口 + runStoryTransition(...) 调用 + 返回文本格式化 + 必要 re-export。

happy.desc: story-advance.ts 不再包含 inline git merge / git worktree remove / actor 生命周期编排 / gate 串接代码 -> rg 搜索 git merge|git worktree remove|createStoryActor|actor\.start|actor\.send|actor\.stop|runReviewToTestPreflightGate|runValidateGate|runDonePreMergeGate|applyDoneMergeEffects 的调用体（非 import/re-export）在 story-advance.ts 零命中; WHY: 证明 thin handler 不再包含 inline 协调（硬验收 #4）
story-advance.ts 的 story_advance 函数体只包含：参数解析 + runStoryTransition(...) 单一调用 + 返回文本格式化 -> 函数体行数显著下降（对比 365 行基线）; WHY: 证明 thin handler 是真正委托而非移注释
story-advance.ts 保留必要 re-export（cleanStrayWorktreeFiles / STRAY_FILE_WHITELIST / buildDoneChecklist / DoneCheckRow）-> 现有外部 import 不 break; WHY: 保持向后兼容

edge.desc: story-advance.ts 不再 import createStoryActor / getStateName / PHASE_TO_EVENT 等 transition 内部符号（这些只在 orchestrator 内部使用）-> import 语句检查确认; WHY: thin handler 不应持有它不使用的 import

story-advance.ts 不再 import acquireDoneMainMergeLock / detectDoneStoryWorktreeContext / assertDoneStoryBranchMatches / autoSyncMain / checkMainDivergence 等 DONE 专属符号 -> 这些全由 orchestrator 间接使用; WHY: 确认 DONE 路径的所有协调已完全委托

story-advance.ts 不再包含 4 段 inline advisory 计算（depsWarning / sessionWarning / baselineRiskWarning / initCheckAdvisory）的实现体 -> 这些逻辑已移入 orchestrator 或作为 orchestrator 返回结构的字段; WHY: thin handler 不应持有 advisory 计算逻辑

adversarial.desc: story-advance.ts 中搜索 try.*finally 块 -> 只允许 orchestrator 调用外层的必要 error handling，不允许存在 inline try/finally 管理 actor 或 lock; WHY: 对抗表面委托但实际 story-advance.ts 仍 inline 管理生命周期的假 thin
story-advance.ts 中搜索 if.*args.phase.*===.*DONE / if.*phase.*DONE 等 DONE 路径分支 -> 零命中（所有 phase 分支逻辑在 orchestrator 内部）; WHY: 对抗部分委托——DONE 路径仍留在 story-advance.ts 的假 thin
全仓 rg story-advance.ts 的所有 import 路径确认无外部模块直接引用 story-advance.ts 的内部实现符号（除 re-export 的）-> 排除隐式依赖链阻止重构; WHY: 对抗外部模块绕过 orchestrator 直接依赖 story-advance.ts 内部实现

items.title: Regression-prove zero CLI/semantics change and no circular imports
items.context: Extend smoke/contract coverage to prove: external CLI behavior (story_advance for every transition), TEST semantics, legacy phase handling, and workflow profile are all unchanged; the new modules have clear single responsibilities with no circular imports; StoryPhase / legacy phase types are untouched. Run build + flow-stability + validation-protocol + lifecycle-registry-contract + process-fact-contract + runtime-fact-contract + worktree-authority-smoke. Regression must prove behavior preservation while allowing internal ownership cleanup: no phase timing changes, no TEST/legacy/profile semantics changes, no circular imports, no global/shared hidden handoff.
items.userSees: 开发者跑回归套件（build + flow-stability + validation-protocol + lifecycle-registry-contract + process-fact-contract + runtime-fact-contract + worktree-authority-smoke）看到 ✓ 全过——各 transition 外部行为 byte-identical、DONE phase 写入时机不变、无循环 import、无 global/shared hidden handoff。

happy.desc: koala validate 全绿（build + flow-stability + validation-protocol + lifecycle-registry-contract + process-fact-contract + runtime-fact-contract + worktree-authority-smoke）-> 输出 allPass:true; WHY: 证明重构没有破坏任何现有 contract/smoke

worktree-authority-smoke 中 assertDoneSuccessPathOutputAndOrdering 通过 -> DONE 成功路径的 checklist 段 + advance line + merge-report lines + step ordering (merge -> worktree remove -> branch delete) 全部 byte-identical; WHY: 证明 DONE 路径外部输出零变化（硬验收 #3 的成功路径）
worktree-authority-smoke 中 assertDoneOracleGateFailureKeepsStoryTest 通过 -> pre-merge gate 失败时 story 仍 TEST，phase=DONE 从未写入; WHY: 证明 DONE phase timing 不变——pre-merge gate 失败语义保持（硬验收 #3 的失败路径）
worktree-authority-smoke 中新增或已有的循环 import 检测断言通过 -> transition-orchestrator.ts 与 phase-gates.ts / transition-effects.ts / done-effects.ts / story-advance.ts 之间无循环 import; WHY: 证明模块依赖是 DAG 而非循环
tsc --noEmit 全仓编译通过 -> 重构未引入类型错误; WHY: 编译级证明代码完整性

edge.desc: worktree-authority-smoke 中 assertStrayFileOffenderKeepsStoryTest 通过 -> stray-file pre-merge gate 失败时 story 仍 TEST; WHY: 确认 DONE 的第二条 pre-merge gate（F-020 stray-file）的失败语义在 orchestrator 接管后不变
worktree-authority-smoke 中 assertMergeConflictPreMergeGateKeepsStoryTest 通过 -> merge conflict 时 story 仍 TEST 且 branch 未被 force-sync; WHY: 确认 merge conflict 这一 edge case 在 orchestrator 接管后行为不变

worktree-authority-smoke 中 assertRealMergeFailureMarksDoneAndThrows + assertWorktreeCleanupFailureMarksDoneMergedAndThrows 通过 -> post-merge 失败时 story 已 DONE 且 throw 含手动恢复指引; WHY: 确认 DONE post-merge 语义（phase 已写但后续失败的处理）在 orchestrator 接管后不变

worktree-authority-smoke 中 assertDoneMainMergeLiveLockFailsBeforeMutation + assertDoneMainMergeLockBlocksBeforeAutoSyncMain + assertDoneMainMergeStaleLockIsReclaimed 通过 -> DONE merge lock 的 live/stale 行为在 orchestrator 接管后不变; WHY: 确认并发 DONE 串行化语义保持

各 transition（INIT_CHECK / PLAN / DEV / REVIEW / TEST / DONE + REPLAN 回退）的 story_advance 外部 CLI 输出与重构前 byte-identical -> 4 段 inline advisory（deps/session/baseline-risk/init-check）文本顺序和内容不变; WHY: 覆盖非 DONE 路径的行为保持

adversarial.desc: 手动构造 transition-orchestrator.ts import story-advance.ts 或 story-advance.ts import transition-orchestrator.ts 再 import story-advance.ts 的循环路径 -> tsc 或运行时报错; WHY: 对抗搬迁引入隐式循环 import
检查 transition-orchestrator.ts 不使用 globalThis 或模块级 mutable state 传递跨函数数据 -> 无 global/shared hidden handoff（对比 B-9027 消除的 __koalaDoneChecklistRendered）; WHY: 对抗用新的 global 变量替代旧的隐式耦合

story-advance.ts 的结构化断言：不含 git merge / git worktree remove 的 inline 实现（已有 assertDoneSuccessPathOutputAndOrdering CHK-003 task 2 第四项）-> regex 断言在 smoke 中通过; WHY: 对抗 thin handler 名义委托但实际保留 inline git 操作的回归
删除 transition-orchestrator.ts 后 tsc --noEmit 报错且 story_advance CLI 不可用 -> 证明 story-advance.ts 真正依赖 orchestrator 而非 fallback 到 inline 实现; WHY: 对抗存在 fallback 分支让 orchestrator 成为死代码的假委托
